configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that is shown in the in-game server list. No semi-colons allowed

configurationFields.label: Spielmodus
configurationFields.description: Sets the game mode for new players

configurationFields.label: Force Game Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will send game mode values to clients other than the one saved during world creation, if those values are set in 'server.properties' after world creation

configurationFields.label: Level Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the level (world) to load, or create if it does not exist. No semi-colons allowed, nor any symbols that are illegal for file names. Levels are stored in the 'worlds' directory

configurationFields.label: Level Seed
configurationFields.description: Sets the seed to randomise the generation of a new world. Empty = random seed

configurationFields.label: Level Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the type of map that is generated for a new world

configurationFields.label: Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level of the world

configurationFields.label: Allow Cheats
configurationFields.description: If set, cheats like commands can be used

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Enable Online Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, all connected players must be authenticated to Xbox Live. Remote clients must always be authenticated, even if this setting is disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable LAN Visibility
configurationFields.description: WARNING: READ THIS BEFORE ENABLING THIS SETTING! This setting enables LAN discoverability of the server. It only applies when Transport is RakNet, and then only if the Server Ports allocated in GSCS to your server are 19132 and 19133. Otherwise, your server will either not start or will not be joinable

configurationFields.label: Enable Allow List
configurationFields.description: If set, all connected players must be listed in 'allowlist.json'

configurationFields.label: View Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowed view distance. Higher values have performance impact

configurationFields.label: Tick Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the distance from any player that the world will be ticked. Higher values have performance impact

configurationFields.label: Idle Player Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time after which a player will be kicked if idling. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Default Player Permission Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the permission level for new players joining the server for the first time

configurationFields.label: Require Texture Packs
configurationFields.description: If set, clients must use texture packs in the current world

configurationFields.label: Chat Restriction Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the level of restriction applied to the chat for each player that joins the server

configurationFields.label: Ignore Player Interaction
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will inform clients to ignore other players when interacting with the world

configurationFields.label: Enable Client Chunk Generation
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will inform clients that they have the ability to generate visual level chunks outside of player interaction distances

configurationFields.label: Server Build Radius Ratio
configurationFields.description: Sets how much of the player's view the server will generate, disregarding client hardware capability. Allowed values = Disabled or any value in range 0.0 - 1.0. Client Chunk Generation must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Disable Custom Skins
configurationFields.description: If set, custom skins that were customised outside of the Minecraft store assets or in game assets will not be allowed

configurationFields.label: Maximum CPU Threads
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of CPU threads the server will try to use. 0 = use as many as possible

configurationFields.label: Enable Content Errors Logging
configurationFields.description: If set, logging content errors to a file will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Compression Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the smallest size of raw network payload to compress

configurationFields.label: Compression Algorithm
configurationFields.description: Sets the compression algorithm to use for networking

configurationFields.label: Player Position Tolerance Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the tolerance of discrepancies between the client and server player position, if the third option is selected under Server Movement Authority

configurationFields.label: Player Attack/Look Direction Tolerance Threshold
configurationFields.description: Specifies the amount that the player's attack direction and look direction can differ

configurationFields.label: Server Authority Block Breaking Pick Range Scalar
configurationFields.description: Sets the pick range scalar if Server Authority Block Breaking is enabled

configurationFields.label: Hash Block Network IDs
configurationFields.description: Specifies if the server will send hashed block network ID's instead of id's that start from 0 and go up

configurationFields.label: Allow Outbound Script Debugging
configurationFields.description: If set, allows use of the script debugger 'connect' command and 'Connect' for the Script Debugger Auto-Attach Mode

configurationFields.label: Allow Inbound Script Debugging
configurationFields.description: If set, allows use of the script debugger 'listen' command and 'Listen' for the Script Debugger Auto-Attach Mode

configurationFields.label: Script Debugger Auto-Attach Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the behavior of the script debugger auto-attach feature

configurationFields.label: Script Debugger Auto-Attach Connect Address
configurationFields.description: Sets the address to use when the Script Debugger Auto-Attach Mode is set to 'Connect'. Make sure to use the Debugger Port allocated to the instance

configurationFields.label: Strict Player Movement Checks
configurationFields.description: If set, the server is stricter about the client-reported player position and sends more corrections. Players near moving blocks on a high latency connection are affected most

configurationFields.label: Strict Dismount Checks
configurationFields.description: If set, the server is stricter about the player dismount position and corrects clients on a high latency connection

configurationFields.label: Strict Entity Interaction Checks
configurationFields.description: If set, the server is stricter about entity interactions. Players interacting with each other on a high latency connection are affected most

configurationFields.label: Disable Vibrant Visuals
configurationFields.description: If set, the server tells clients to use the next best available graphics setting instead of Vibrant Visuals. Leave unset to use the server default

configurationFields.label: Transport
configurationFields.description: Sets the network transport the server uses. RakNet is the classic UDP transport and uses both the IPv4 and IPv6 Server Ports allocated in GSCS. NetherNet is WebRTC based: it ignores the IPv6 Server Port and opens a dual-stack socket on the IPv4 Server Port instead, and carries client traffic on the UDP Transport Port allocated in GSCS

options.raknet: RakNet (legacy - refused by current server builds)

configurationFields.label: Allow Players To Join
configurationFields.description: If not set, players cannot join the server unless explicitly allowed by scripting (via AsyncPlayerJoinBeforeEvent)

configurationFields.label: Enable Content Errors Console Output
configurationFields.description: If set, content errors will also be written to the console

configurationFields.label: Content Log Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum content log level that will be recorded, with Error being the highest level

configurationFields.label: Script Debugger Listen Address
configurationFields.description: Sets the address used for the inbound (listen) debugger mode. A non-loopback address requires a Script Debugger Passcode and exposes debugging access to the network

configurationFields.label: Script Debugger Auto-Attach Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets how long the server waits at world load for a debugger to attach. Leave unset to use the server default

configurationFields.label: Script Debugger Passcode
configurationFields.description: Sets the passcode that VSCode will prompt the user for when connecting. Required when the Script Debugger Listen Address is not a loopback address

configurationFields.label: Enable Script Watchdog
configurationFields.description: If set, the script watchdog is enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Script Watchdog Exception Handling
configurationFields.description: If set, watchdog exceptions can be handled by scripts via the events.beforeWatchdogTerminate event

configurationFields.label: Enable Script Watchdog Shutdown
configurationFields.description: If set, the server shuts down when a watchdog exception goes unhandled

configurationFields.label: Throw Script Watchdog Hang Exception
configurationFields.description: If set, a critical exception is thrown when a hang occurs, interrupting script execution

configurationFields.label: Script Watchdog Hang Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the watchdog threshold for a hang within a single tick

configurationFields.label: Script Watchdog Spike Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the watchdog threshold for a spike within a single tick. Leave unset to disable the warning, which is the server default

configurationFields.label: Script Watchdog Slow Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the watchdog threshold for slow scripts spanning multiple ticks. Leave unset to disable the warning, which is the server default

configurationFields.label: Script Watchdog Memory Warning
configurationFields.description: Writes a content log warning when combined script memory usage exceeds this threshold. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Script Watchdog Memory Limit
configurationFields.description: Saves and shuts down the world when combined script memory usage exceeds this threshold. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Auto-Start Diagnostics Capture
configurationFields.description: If set, a diagnostics capture session is started at world load

configurationFields.label: Maximum Diagnostics Capture Files
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of diagnostics capture files to keep before cycling

configurationFields.label: Maximum Diagnostics Capture File Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the size the current diagnostics capture file may reach before the server cycles to a new file

configurationFields.label: Enable Editor Network Metrics
configurationFields.description: If set, network metrics are collected so live diagnostics can be shown in the debugger. Leave unset to use the server default

configurationFields.label: Sentry Rate Limit Window
configurationFields.description: Sets the window over which scripting errors reported to Sentry are rate limited. 0 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Sentry Maximum Events Per Window
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of events allowed within the Sentry Rate Limit Window. 0 = do not send events to Sentry

configurationFields.label: Maximum Persistent Ticking Areas
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of persistent ticking areas allowed when adding a new area across all dimensions. Allowed values = unlimited or any positive integer up to 2147483647. Existing saved areas are not removed when this is lowered. Leave blank to use the server default

configurationFields.label: Maximum Persistent Ticking Area Chunks
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of chunks allowed when adding a new persistent ticking area. Allowed values = unlimited or any positive integer up to 2147483647. Existing saved areas are not removed when this is lowered. Leave blank to use the server default

configurationFields.label: Maximum Transient Ticking Area Chunks
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum aggregate number of unique chunks in transient ticking areas for each behavior pack. Allowed values = unlimited or any positive integer up to 2147483647. Higher values and unlimited significantly affect server performance and memory use. Leave blank to use the server default

configurationFields.label: Enable Server Authority Block Breaking
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will compute block mining operations in sync with the client, so it can verify that the client should be able to break the blocks it thinks it can

configurationFields.label: Enable Server Telemetry
configurationFields.description: If set, server telemetry will be enabled, resulting in server data being sent to Microsoft

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional settings to include in 'server.properties' that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line. Useful for new settings in preview server builds

configurationFields.label: Server Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the server version to install. If a "specific version" is selected, the version must be set under Specific Server Version Identifier. Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: Specific Server Version Identifier
configurationFields.description: Sets the version identifier for a specific Bedrock version to install, if a "specific version" is selected under Server Version. Must be the full four number identifier as appropriate to the build stream. See [release versions](https://github.com/Cybrancee/Minecraft-Bedrock-Versions?tab=readme-ov-file#minecraft-versions). Update the server after changing this setting
